description: This file defines backbone modules for an object detection model, including a frozen batch normalization layer, backbone base class, specific ResNet backbone, and a joiner class for combining backbone outputs with position encodings. It also includes a function to build the backbone model based on input arguments.

classes.name: FrozenBatchNorm2d
classes.description: A BatchNorm2d layer with fixed batch statistics and affine parameters.

classes.name: BackboneBase
classes.description: Base class for backbone networks, managing layer freezing and intermediate layer outputs.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, configurable via arguments.

classes.name: Joiner
classes.description: Sequential module combining backbone and position embedding, producing outputs and positional encodings.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict
methods.description: Loads state dict, handling 'num_batches_tracked' key removal for FrozenBatchNorm2d.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Computes the forward pass for FrozenBatchNorm2d, BackboneBase, Backbone, and Joiner classes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializers for FrozenBatchNorm2d, BackboneBase, Backbone, and Joiner classes.

methods.name: build_backbone
methods.description: Constructs the backbone model with position encoding based on input arguments.
